subtitle: The different shapes a Fusion integration can take

steps.label: Batch / bulk
steps.sub: large volumes on a schedule — FBDI covers this in another course

steps.label: Real-time REST
steps.sub: individual records, as this course has shown — invoices, journals, lookups

steps.label: Event-driven
steps.sub: Fusion announces something happened; a subscriber reacts

eyebrow: Four questions that decide the pattern

steps.label: Volume
steps.sub: ten records a day, or a hundred thousand?

steps.label: Latency
steps.sub: does it need to happen in seconds, or is overnight fine?

steps.label: Direction
steps.sub: data going into Fusion, or coming out of it?

steps.label: Frequency
steps.sub: one-time migration, or an ongoing, recurring feed?

code:
10,000 legacy invoices, once, at go-live:
  -> batch/bulk (FBDI)

One invoice created by a vendor portal, now:
  -> real-time REST (this course)

"Notify finance the moment an invoice posts":
  -> event-driven (Chapter 4, later lessons)
caption: The same data, AP invoices, routed through three different patterns depending on the scenario.
